question: Who has an interview in the next three days, and has each of them had a call since their last stage change?
sql: SELECT c.name AS candidate_name, cl.name AS client_name, r.title AS role_title, a.stage AS stage, a.next_interview_at AS interview_at, a.stage_updated AS stage_updated, (SELECT MAX(act.at) FROM activities act WHERE act.candidate_id = a.candidate_id AND act.kind = 'call' AND act.with_party = 'candidate') AS last_call_date, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities act WHERE act.candidate_id = a.candidate_id AND act.kind = 'call' AND act.with_party = 'candidate' AND act.at >= a.stage_updated) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS call_since_stage_change FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id JOIN roles r ON r.id = a.role_id JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = r.client_id WHERE a.status = 'active' AND a.next_interview_at IS NOT NULL AND substr(a.next_interview_at,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-11-25' AND date('2026-11-25', '+3 day') ORDER BY a.next_interview_at LIMIT 200
answer: Five candidates have interviews in the next three days: Grace Holloway (26 Nov, Brackenvane Trading), Ines Duarte (26 Nov, Lumenfold Research), Arjun Nair (27 Nov, Lumenfold Research), Aisha Karim (27 Nov, Fernhallow Capital) and Laura Schmidt (27 Nov, Brackenvane Trading). Ines Duarte, Aisha Karim and Laura Schmidt have had a call since their last stage change, but Grace Holloway (last call 6 Nov, stage changed 13 Nov) and Arjun Nair (last call 18 Nov, stage changed 20 Nov) have not.

meta.note: Active applications with an interview from today to +3 days inclusive; 'call since stage change' means a candidate call dated on or after stage_updated.
